trust_decision.summary: When Glances runs without --password, which configuration/argument values may be served to unauthenticated API clients; decided by key-name filtering only in Config.as_dict_secure() and GlancesRestfulApi._sanitize_args(), with no value-level (URL userinfo) check and no `user`/`username`/`login` key pattern.

landing_point.why: The summary names as_dict_secure() and /api/4/config; that method and its key regex at glances/config.py:28-31 are where an engineer would go first.

fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP handler helper (second sanitiser over argparse namespace)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: glances/outputs/glances_restful_api.py:1363-1378 (_sanitize_args: separate hand-maintained key list for /api/4/args, patched in fix.diff:91)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For /api/4/args the fix's own test docstring concedes no reachable leak (`-u <login>` forces a password, fix.diff:116-118), so a solver can argue args is out of scope; for the O8 limits/ports routes a solver can argue they are 'plugin stats/thresholds', not 'the configuration endpoint' the advisory names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: CPU/load `user_careful`/`user_warning`/`user_critical` thresholds must stay visible (a naive `user` substring pattern masks them and breaks the Web UI); non-string args (bools, port, refresh time) must keep their types; the authenticated view must stay complete; the Web UI also fetches /api/4/all/limits for thresholds so blanket-redacting limits breaks it.

O6_input_shapes: URL value with userinfo scheme://user:pass@host -> userinfo only redacted
URL value with user-only userinfo scheme://user@host
same rules applied to argparse values (username_used, client)

O7_producer.where: glances/plugins/plugin/model.py:737-746 (load_limits copies every key of the plugin's config section, e.g. [ip] public_username/public_password/public_api, into plugin limits)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/4/{plugin}/limits returns the plugin's limits dict, which holds every raw key of the same-named config section (e.g. ip_public_password, ip_public_username, ip_public_api) with no redaction
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: limits are 'alert thresholds', not the configuration endpoint named in the advisory
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (glances/plugins/plugin/model.py:737-746 producer) from glances/config.py landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/4/all/limits returns all plugins' limits via Stats.getAllLimitsAsDict, same unredacted config copy; consumed by the Web UI
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Web UI needs it for thresholds; looks like a stats endpoint

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MCP resources glances://limits and glances://limits/{plugin} serialize the same unredacted limits
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: different transport/feature (MCP), not the REST API in the report

O8_uncovered_routes.route: XML-RPC getAllLimits returns the same unredacted limits
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: legacy client/server XML-RPC mode with its own auth, not the REST API

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/4/ports (plugin stats) returns web_N_url values and proxy URLs from [ports] verbatim, so URL userinfo leaks even though as_dict_secure now masks it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it is monitoring output the plugin is meant to show, not the configuration
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: glances/web_list.py + glances/plugins/ports/__init__.py:83-86, different package from landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a get_limits(secure=True) style view that redacts by key name only, missing URL userinfo values
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the maintainer's existing pattern is key-name filtering (glances/config.py:28-31); copying it to limits is the natural first step

O8b_injection_room.sibling: proxy URL values (http_proxy/https_proxy with userinfo) carried into exported ports stats
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: proxies already flow into stats dicts; redacting only 'url' and forgetting nested proxies dict is a plausible maintainer miss (input-shape: nested dict)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: per-item args/config route that reads the raw value before sanitising
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: item routes are thin wrappers and are often written to index the raw dict for speed

O9_family: CWE-200 information exposure: credential redaction in an unauthenticated read-only API (secrets in config/arg values)

O10_build.toolchain: pip/uv install of glances with web extras (fastapi, uvicorn), pytest
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_restful.py (starts a server, hits all/limits and {plugin}/limits at tests/test_restful.py:185-211), tests/test_mcp.py (limits resources); no as_dict_secure/_sanitize_args unit tests at the pinned commit; fix adds tests/test_api_secure.py (pure unit, no server)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `public_username`/`username` (or a `user` substring) to _SECURE_SENSITIVE_KEY_RE in glances/config.py:29 and stop, leaving URL userinfo, /api/4/args and the limits/ports routes open (and masking cpu user_* thresholds).
